newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on political uncertainty.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Wednesday amid political uncertainty ahead of elections on February 3, dealers said.
They said the IMF's decision to resume a standby loan had failed to move the market, which was unsure if the next government would be able to meet the agreed targets.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 13.54 points, or 0.97 percent, to close at 1,382.21. Losers led gainers 155 to 58.
Pakistan State Oil fell 9.0 rupees to 278 rupees and Hub Power Co 0.50 to 31.90.
Another dealer said the IMF's decision to resume a standby loan had failed to move the market, which was unsure if the next government would be able to meet the agreed targets.
PSO dived 9.00 rupees to 278, Pak Oilfields 1.00 to 67, Parke Davis 5.00 to 550, Dewan Salman 1.65 to 28.35, HUBCO 0.60 to 31.90 and ICI 0.55 to 18.15. PTCL rose 0.05 to 27.10.
